Question 10
?

8x4−4x3+6x2+4x−32x2−x+2=

a
4x2−1+2x2−x+23x−1
b
3x−1+4x2+12x2−x+2
c
4x2−1+3x−12x2−x+2
d
4x2+1−3x−12x2−x+2
e
4x2+1+3x−12x2−x+2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

2x2−x+24x2−12x2−x+28x4−4x3+6x2+4x−32x2−x+28x4−4x3+8x2―2x2−x+28x4−4x3−2x2+4x−32x2−x+28x4−4x3−2x2+0x−2―2x2−x+28x4−4x3+6x2+3x−1

As a result,

  • the quotient is 4x2−1, and

  • the remainder is 3x−1.

Therefore, 8x4−4x3+6x2+4x−32x2−x+2=4x2−1+3x−12x2−x+2.
